remarks: Welcome to Unit 27E at 1 Broad Street in Stamford's premier Park Tower, a luxurious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath high-rise condo offering 1,585 sq ft of sun-drenched living space with floor-to-ceiling windows, hardwood floors, a private balcony, and stunning views of the Long Island Sound. This unit features a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops, spacious bedrooms with en-suite baths, in-unit laundry, and ample closet space. Carpets will be replaced before new tenant takes occupancy. Enjoy full access to resort-style amenities including 24/7 concierge, indoor pool, fitness center, sauna, shuttle to Metro-North, and rooftop terrace. Located steps from Mill River Park, downtown dining, shops, and UConn Stamford, with quick access to I-95 and Stamford Station-ideal for NYC commuters. Rent includes basic cable and internet. Pets considered on a case by case basis. Excellent credit and proof of income required.
